text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): loads all households via registry.register.load_households(), computes today/now from the fixed operation clock, pays 60 dollars to each household where eligibility.rules.is_eligible(household, today=today) is True, using the canonical idempotency key payments.vouchers.payment_key(household.id, 2) = \"{household_id}:2\". It pre-checks vouchers.sent_payments() for an existing key and skips duplicates, otherwise calls vouchers.disburse(household.id, 60, key, now=now) which generates the Payment ID and appends to data/outbox/payments.jsonl. No payment IDs are generated in the script and no SMS is sent. Ran it once (P2): 19 eligible households (HH-10421, HH-11878, HH-11959, HH-12084, HH-12572, HH-12793, HH-12882, HH-13137, HH-13862, HH-13870, HH-14087, HH-14354, HH-14423, HH-14605, HH-15108, HH-15393, HH-15595, HH-15695, HH-15709) each received exactly one payment of 60 dollars with key \"{household_id}:2\" (PAY-00018 through PAY-00036). A second run confirmed idempotency: every household was skipped with no new payments appended.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
